business_scope.primary_industry_name: Video Game Kernel-Level Anti-Cheat and Integrity Middleware

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu — International Company regime (VU_IC), VFSC Companies Registry
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — predominantly English common law statute (International Companies Act [CAP 222]), with French civil law and Melanesian customary law influences; offshore company law follows the BVI International Business Companies model
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Vanuatu–China Bilateral Investment Treaty (2006, in force 2007)
Vanuatu–United Kingdom Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement
Accession to the Marrakesh Agreement Establishing the World Trade Organization (2012)
Tax Information Exchange Agreement with Australia (in force)
Tax Information Exchange Agreement with New Zealand (in force)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [CAP 222] of 1992, as amended (including the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2019 introducing beneficial ownership register obligations); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 42 of 2019 (AMLA), as amended; International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019; Financial Dealers Act [CAP 63]; VFSC AML/CFT Supervision Manual and VFSC Beneficial Ownership Guidance; Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) directives implementing UN Security Council financial sanctions
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access — beneficial ownership particulars are filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through the licensed registered agent and are accessible to the VFIU and domestic competent authorities; no public beneficial ownership search exists

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified True Copy of Passport of each Director, Shareholder and Ultimate Beneficial Owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing government passport authority in the document holder's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in country of origin followed by Consular Legalization (Vanuatu is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention; apostilled documents are accepted only where a bilateral arrangement with the issuing state so provides)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Recently dated Proof of Residential Address (utility bill or bank statement, not older than three months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider, licensed bank or government authority in country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in country of origin and Consular Legalization for use in Vanuatu

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original Bank Reference Letter / Professional Opinion addressed to the Vanuatu registered agent (AML risk rating of the account holder)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Account-holding licensed bank or regulated financial institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified by authorized signatory; where issued electronically by a regulated institution no apostille is ordinarily required, otherwise Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Consent to Act as Director and completed Registered Agent CDD/KYC Questionnaire (including source of funds and source of wealth declaration)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in country of residence and VFSC-licensed registered agent in Vanuatu
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in country of origin with countersignature by the Vanuatu registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Incumbency (where any shareholder is a body corporate and corporate UBOs must be pierced to natural persons)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or registered agent of the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille or Consular Legalization as required by the shareholder's home jurisdiction and accepted by the Vanuatu registered agent

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based CDD under ss.4–17 of the AMLA No. 42 of 2019: identity verification of all directors, shareholders and beneficial owners; continuous screening of all parties against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU and UK consolidated sanctions lists, and domestic Vanuatu financial prohibitions; mandatory determination of Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) covering domestic and foreign prominent public functions, family members and close associates; Enhanced Due Diligence and source-of-wealth assessment triggered upon any PEP match; electronic sanctions screening and adverse-media alerts maintained by the registered agent; CDD records retained for at least five years after termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Companies E-Registry / eServices portal; name clearance submissions must be lodged through a VFSC-licensed registered agent (no direct public self-service filing)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names may be registered in English or French (Vanuatu official languages) using Latin script; Bislama statutory equivalents are accepted. Names in non-Latin scripts must be transliterated into romanized equivalents and supported by a certified translation. The name of an International Company must terminate in a recognized limited liability suffix ('Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Incorporated', 'Inc', 'Société Anonyme', 'S.A.' or approved abbreviation) and must not be identical, confusingly similar or misleading in relation to any existing registered name in Vanuatu or in another recognized jurisdiction.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Asset Management (where implying regulated financial activity)
Vanuatu (use requiring written consent of the Minister)
Betting (in the context of a gaming operator licence; not applicable to anti-cheat middleware names that do not connote gambling operations)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the requested name is rejected, the applicant (through the registered agent) may file an amended re-submission with distinctive tokens within 14 days. If the refusal is confirmed, a formal administrative appeal must be lodged in writing with the Registrar of International Companies under Part II of the International Companies Act [CAP 222], upon which the Registrar issues a written decision within 21 business days. A further appeal lies by judicial review application to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the Civil Procedure Rules 2002. Approved names are reserved for 30 calendar days, renewable once upon payment of an additional statutory reservation fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible in form: the statutory registered office and the registered agent must be physical addresses in Vanuatu, but the anti-cheat middleware business may be operated remotely; the VFSC-registered agent's office ordinarily serves as the registered office. The International Company is required to obtain a Certificate of Exemption under s.113 of the International Companies Act [CAP 222] and to file an economic substance declaration; a pure software licensing and engineering revenue model with no Vanuatu operational staff is consistent with International Company status, provided the business does not constitute a relevant activity requiring economic substance in Vanuatu. The International Company is prohibited from carrying on business with the public within Vanuatu and from holding freehold land in Vanuatu.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — estimated 2–5% annual probability of unannounced inspection at the registered agent's Vanuatu office; physical checks of the International Company's own business premises are unlikely because the IC may lawfully conduct its business outside Vanuatu. Inspection powers exist under the AMLA No. 42 of 2019; FATF and Global Forum peer review cycles moderately elevate random compliance inspection and information request risk for nominee and remote-UBO structures.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC incorporation filing fee — standard International Company (share capital not exceeding VT 1,000,000)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies Act [CAP 222] (VFSC Schedule of Fees)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance, search and reservation fee
Appointment of VFSC-licensed registered agent and registered office (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark in the Vanuatu offshore corporate services market

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: CDD, UBO and KYC file compilation; PEP and sanctions screening; AML risk assessment (Low_Risk_Standard tier)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark; compliance work mandated by AMLA No. 42 of 2019

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and Consular Legalization bundle (passport, proof of address, bank reference, consents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary publics in country of origin; Vanuatu diplomatic or consular mission
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing professional notarial and consular tariff rates

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Exemption (s.113 IC Act) with courier delivery
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission / registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee plus standard courier benchmark

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [CAP. 222] of Vanuatu, as amended; sections relating to incorporation, memorandum and articles of association, shares, registered office, registered agent, and directors.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies and International Companies Registry, Port Vila.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation application, together with executed Memorandum and Articles of Association of the International Company.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is required under the International Companies Act [CAP. 222]; paid-up capital, if any, may be subscribed without an escrow account obligation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that this International Company accepts the subscription for ordinary shares as set forth in the register of members and that the Memorandum and Articles of Association are adopted. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company shall be the address maintained by the registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the following appointments are made: director(s) and company secretary as named in the register of officers. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered agent is authorized to file all statutory forms, pay incorporation fees, and receive the Certificate of Incorporation. RESOLVED, that any director may act singly to execute these resolutions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name clearance and corporate profile preparation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies and International Companies Registry.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request for the intended International Company name together with the proposed corporate profile, including business purpose (ISIC 6201 software development). VFSC will check availability against registered names and prohibited terms.
required_dossiers: Identity and address details of each proposed shareholder and director
Declaration of intended principal business activity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, choose an alternative name and resubmit; any refusal notice may be appealed by written request to VFSC with a corrected name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and execution of constitutive documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary public authorized in Vanuatu and the proposed registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association tailored to an International Company. Execute the documents by each subscriber and have the execution witnessed/notarized where required by the registered agent.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as director and company secretary
Consent to act as registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC queries document wording, amend the relevant clauses by board resolution or supplementary document and refile; no new notarization is required if the amendment is clerical.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of incorporation application with VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies and International Companies Registry.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the full incorporation application package electronically or in hard copy to VFSC, accompanied by the prescribed filing fee. Provide the registered office address and registered agent details.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Details of initial shareholder(s) and subscriber shares
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC issues a requisition, respond within 14 days with the requested documentation or legalization; if the application is rejected, cure by amending the offending item and resubmitting the application with an explanatory cover letter.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies and International Companies Registry.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: VFSC reviews the completed application and, upon satisfaction, issues the Certificate of Incorporation and registers the company in the International Companies Register. The registered agent collects the certificate and registers the company in the agent’s internal corporate register.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is withheld, resolve any outstanding compliance queries and request expedited issuance; any delay beyond SLA may be escalated to the VFSC Complaints Officer.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of directors and registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or pass the first written resolution to adopt the registered office, appoint initial directors and company secretary, approve share issuance, and authorize the opening of bank accounts. Record minutes and file the relevant notices with VFSC if required.
required_dossiers: First board resolution or written consent
Minutes of the first board meeting
Register of members and beneficial ownership information
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC requests correction of officer or beneficial ownership records, file an amending notice and update the registers; any late filing penalty may be mitigated by submission of a corrective declaration.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Cooperatives of Vanuatu — no industrial manufacturing license is triggered for office-based ISIC 6201 software development and gaming anti-cheat middleware.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — registration as an International Company under the International Companies Act [CAP. 222] constitutes the enabling authorization for permitted business activity; no separate operating permit is required.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — the activity is exclusively digital software engineering with no onsite manufacturing, chemical use, or physical discharge; no EIA report or environmental registration is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable; the licensed activity generates no industrial wastewater, volatile organic compound emissions, or hazardous waste. General office waste is handled through municipal waste collection under DEPC guidelines.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification for the commercial office premises must be obtained from the Vanuatu Fire Service and the municipal building authority before staff occupancy; office structural load inspections are limited to building code compliance for ordinary office use; no special workplace clearance is required for software-only operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; official PIN: PMB 9019, Port Vila; digital access via the Vanuatu Trade Information Portal (tradeportal.gov.vu) and DCIR taxpayer service counters. International Company (IC) constitution is administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) International Companies Registry.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company is statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu direct taxation; no income tax TIN is required for offshore operations. The VFSC Registry issues a Certificate of Incorporation bearing a unique IC registration number, which functions as the entity's primary legal and fiscal identifier. If the IC voluntarily opts for value added tax (VAT) registration, it must file Form VAT-01 with DCIR together with the VFSC certificate, constitutional documents, registered-office proof, director and shareholder identification, and a local contact address; DCIR then issues a dedicated VAT registration number and certificate. Pure offshore gaming anti-cheat middleware activities require no further tax ID.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu has no corporate income tax, no check-the-box regime, and no hybrid-mismatch or OECD BEPS participation elections. Available statutory elections are: (i) voluntary VAT registration under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 246] for entities making taxable supplies in Vanuatu notwithstanding fiscal neutrality; and (ii) entity conversion or redomiciliation under the International Companies Act [Cap 222], including continuation as a domestic company, which would preserve income tax neutrality but extend full VAT exposure. An IC cannot elect pass-through taxation because the IC category is exempt at entity level by statutory operation (section 169 of the International Companies Act).

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 246], administered by DCIR
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 4,000,000 in annual taxable supplies (compulsory registration threshold); voluntary registration available below threshold
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, government fiscal-API, or digital stamping mandate is in force. VAT-registered suppliers issue free-format sequentially numbered tax invoices containing prescribed particulars (supplier name and VAT number, invoice date, description, and tax-exclusive/inclusive amounts). VAT returns are filed periodically; customs export declarations are cleared digitally through the ASYCUDA World platform, which constitutes the export evidence record for zero-rating.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods qualify for 0% VAT where they are physically exported from Vanuatu by the supplier within 28 days of supply, or within a longer period permitted by the Commissioner. Services qualify at 0% where supplied to a non-resident for use and enjoyment wholly outside Vanuatu, supported by documentary proof of offshore benefit. Gaming anti-cheat middleware supplied electronically as SaaS or licensed software to foreign game operators and paid via SWIFT or Stripe falls outside the territorial scope of Vanuatu VAT; an IC transacting exclusively offshore is outside the VAT net entirely and need not claim zero-rating unless voluntarily VAT-registered.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Approved Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World electronic export entry)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export departure from Vanuatu
Commercial invoice and packing list (for tangible goods)
Signed offshore service contract and beneficiary-use statement (for anti-cheat middleware/SaaS services)
Overseas bank remittance or payment receipt from the foreign gaming operator (recommended evidence)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu has no exchange-control regime and imposes no statutory FX repatriation deadline; export proceeds may be held offshore indefinitely. False zero-rating claims, under-declaration, or fraudulent misstatements expose the taxpayer to recovery of uncollected VAT, statutory default interest, monetary penalties up to VUV 1,000,000, imprisonment up to five years, and cancellation of VAT registration. An International Company that breaches the International Companies Act offshore restrictions (e.g., transacting with Vanuatu residents or holding local property) risks loss of its section 169 exemption, retrospective tax clawback, fines, and deregistration by the VFSC.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates a liberalized exchange-control regime administered by the RBV under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 54]. The Vanuatu International Company, being a non-resident class entity under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], is statutorily exempt from exchange-control licensing approvals; the VUV is fully convertible for current and capital account transactions conducted outside Vanuatu, and outbound dividend and profit remittances are unrestricted and free of Vanuatu withholding taxes. The only practical constraint is market depth: the VUV is a thinly traded Pacific currency, so the treasury should remain USD-naturalized and avoid material VUV conversions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No surrender obligation applies. Vanuatu imposes neither a statutory timeline nor a mandatory conversion ratio for export receipts; the International Company may retain 100% of all export and merchant proceeds in USD-denominated accounts, whether held domestically or offshore, without obligatory repatriation or conversion into VUV.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium feasibility with material compliance constraints. Established offshore digital EMIs and multi-currency platforms can service the entity for merchant settlement and vendor disbursements only where they explicitly accept Pacific-registered offshore International Companies; most top-tier EMIs apply automatic enhanced due diligence due to Vanuatu's historical inclusion in FATF and EU watchlists. Any approved EMI must operate strictly as a pass-through payment facilitator, never as a deposit-taking re-layer, with direct settlement into the VU_IC's own corporate account supported by a primary relationship with a Vanuatu-licensed bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attestation is predominantly required. Vanuatu-licensed banks generally mandate at least one natural-person director or the appointed registered agent to attend a face-to-face KYC interview at the Port Vila branch or an approved correspondent office; fully remote video-only onboarding is not available for a newly incorporated non-resident International Company without an existing bank referral. Some banks accept a wet-signed certified-copy package, comprising certificate of incorporation, articles, certificate of incumbency, original board resolutions and passport copies, combined with a bank-managed video verification and subsequent deposit of originals by the registered agent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Onboarding of a non-resident, tax-exempt International Company in a jurisdiction historically referenced in FATF/EU AML and tax watchlists, triggering automatic enhanced due diligence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Statutory tax-exempt status confirmation issued by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission; registered agent letter; complete UBO register and organizational chart; incorporation certificate and articles; narrative software export business plan; declaration of no trading with Vanuatu residents.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: 'Gaming' denomination on corporate name and payment descriptor causing a false-positive classification as a gambling or gaming operator, a prohibited high-risk vertical during underwriting
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: ISIC 6201 / NAICS 541511 industry classification memorandum; product whitepaper on kernel-level anti-cheat middleware; executed license agreements with game publishers; platform settlement statements evidencing B2B subscription revenue; written representation that the company conducts no gambling, betting, sweepstakes or player-fund custodianship.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity inbound merchant payouts via Stripe combined with multi-country vendor wire disbursements, flagged as potential layering through an offshore entity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Reconciled six-month revenue pipeline and Stripe settlement history; approved vendor and contractor register with individual KYC snapshots; board-approved disbursement policy; receipts-to-disbursements correlation report; audit-ready accounting ledger.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial owner or director residency in a high-risk or politically exposed jurisdiction, including sanctions-adjacent regional watchlists
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent enhanced background report; source-of-wealth statement supported by verifiable asset, employment or portfolio records; PEP declaration and monitoring consent; co-signed attestation by the Vanuatu licensed registered agent; clean screening output from a SWIFT-compliant sanctions and watchlist engine.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Zero-tax jurisdiction perception as a shell or invoice-mill structure lacking economic substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Substance folder containing cloud infrastructure hosting contracts, source-code escrow agreement, engineering payroll records, board minutes, signed FATCA and CRS self-certifications, including Form W-8BEN-E for any US-source flows, and downstream vendor due diligence evidence.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity injection shall be routed by SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's bank using the unambiguous narrative 'Share Capital Contribution - VU_IC' and the standard bank purpose code for paid-in capital; RBV exchange-control pre-approval is not required for the non-resident IC class, but the receiving bank will file balance-of-payments statistical records, so the wire must be mirrored by a board resolution authorizing share issuance, an updated share register and a source-of-wealth statement. All inbound injections must be cross-reconciled with the Stripe settlement ledger to demonstrate identical treasury identity.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operating settlements for subcontract engineering, cloud infrastructure, licensing fees and agent retainers shall be cleared via SWIFT MT103 with reference narratives matching the underlying commercial contract and invoice number; SWIFT MT202 is reserved for nostro funding between the entity's treasury accounts. Where a counterparty requires bank-undertaking settlement, an irrevocable at-sight Commercial Letter of Credit governed by UCP 600 may be opened through the RBV-licensed bank, while recurring middleware subscription disbursements default to MT103 as the cost-efficient rail; Stripe remains the inbound acquisition rail configured to cascade daily merchant payouts into the USD operational account.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/VUV FX forwards with tenor up to 12 months executed with an RBV-licensed dealing bank in Port Vila
Cross-currency swaps (USD/VUV) for converting residual local-currency balances into USD treasury

Non-deliverable forwards (USD/VUV) with an offshore counterparty, permissible only for bridge-tenor windows where a local forward is unavailable, subject to the shallow VUV offshore market and wide quoting
Plain-vanilla USD/VUV FX options (calls and puts) for contingent hedging of local operating expenses

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of International Company (prescribed form under the International Companies Act, Cap. 222)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days following each anniversary of the date of incorporation (e.g., anniversary 20 March 2025 -> due 19 April 2025)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: VFSC may issue a late-filing notice and impose an administrative penalty; repeated default for 90 days exposes the company to summary strike-off and director restoration restrictions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Renewal Fee (annual license fee maintained by VFSC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) via the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on each anniversary of incorporation; the agent usually bills 30 days before the due date (renewal valid until the next anniversary)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Default without payment within 30 days triggers a late-payment surcharge and issuance of a strike-off warning; continued non-payment for 3 months results in administrative dissolution under the International Companies Act and the property of the company vests in VFSC in accordance with the Act.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual registered agent confirmation of registered office and UBO register (if no change, the annual return serves as confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC through the licensed registered agent (kept on file for inspection by competent authorities)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same 30-day anniversary window as the annual return; any mid-year UBO change must be filed within 14 days of the event.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain current UBO and registered office details can trigger agent's statutory resignation, a 14-day public notice, and subsequent strike-off for company inactivity.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Unconditional exemption: International Companies under Cap. 222 are not subject to statutory audit regardless of revenue, assets, employees, or number of shareholders. An audit is only required if the company's constitutional documents or a lender/investor agreement mandate one, or if the company elects to be taxable as a local company.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory accounting standard. IFRS adopted by most service providers; local Vanuatu GAAP is not prescribed for International Companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed agent maintains the UBO register; any shareholding transfer or change of beneficial owner must be notified to the agent within 14 days. The annual return filed by the agent includes a declaration that the UBO particulars remain true; if changed, an updated UBO schedule is attached. VFSC does not maintain a public UBO register, but records are available to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit upon lawful request.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$2,000 - US$5,000 (voluntary audit only; no statutory audit mandate)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no payroll tax, no estate or gift tax, and no social security surcharge on any resident or non-resident taxpayer.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective rate. International Companies (ICs) are expressly exempt from all Vanuatu direct and indirect taxes, including VAT on exported software, import duties on licensed engineering assets, and stamp duty on share transfers; the annual VFSC government fee is the only recurring charge.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Vanuatu has no corporate income tax return. The mandatory annual instrument is the VFSC International Company Annual Return (Form VU-IC-AR), filed by the licensed Registered Agent through the VFSC e-Registry portal on behalf of the IC.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within six calendar months after the anniversary of incorporation; a 30-business-day VFSC administrative grace period applies only if the Registered Agent has issued a prior written reminder.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VFSC registration number, current and former corporate names, incorporation date and company type (IC).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the exact certificate number. No foreign tax reference number is required for the IC itself.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical street address in Vanuatu and the name, licence number and contact details of the VFSC-licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident cannot be the registered agent. Appoint a Port Vila agent and insert its licensed address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name, nationality, ordinary residential address and appointment date of each director and corporate officer.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominee directors are permitted, but current photo-ID and identity-verification documents must be lodged with the agent when the director is non-resident.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Share classes, issued and paid-up capital, number of shares, and the register of beneficial owners.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose the ultimate natural-person beneficial owner to the agent under Vanuatu's beneficial ownership transparency framework; bearer shares are abolished.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal business activity in ISIC v4 terms, worldwide gross revenue in Vatu, and confirmation that the company does not carry on business with Vanuatu residents.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Describe the activity as ISIC 6201 Computer programming, consultancy and related services (gaming anti-cheat middleware licensing) and substantiate that all licence contracts are negotiated and executed outside Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of local employees, local physical premises, local expenditure, and the location where core income-generating activities (CIGA) are performed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign software engineers may be listed as remote support staff; however, at least one annual board meeting physically held in Vanuatu, local minutes and evidence of local CIGA management must be retained for inspection.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a VT 25,000 monthly VFSC surcharge and a VT 50,000 fixed late fee. Knowingly false returns attract the maximum criminal fine of VT 10,000,000 and/or two years' imprisonment. Failure to file for three consecutive years causes automatic strike-off, vesting of assets in the Republic, and cancellation of the IC registration.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu enacts no dividend withholding tax, no branch remittance tax, and no undistributed profits tax; an IC may distribute its entire anti-cheat license revenue to shareholders free of Vanuatu tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double-taxation agreements and no MLI coverage; therefore no TRC-based treaty relief protocol exists. A foreign parent seeking a formal position may request a Certificate of Tax Status from the Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department; that certificate confirms the IC's zero-tax standing for foreign-audit evidence but cannot impose or waive a source-country withholding right.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory rate: 0% on outbound royalties and 0% on outbound interest; treaty rate: not applicable due to the absence of DTAs. Cross-border license fees for the anti-cheat engine, technology royalties and intercompany loan interest may leave Vanuatu entirely untaxed, provided the IC does not generate Vanuatu-source income.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Vanuatu has not enacted transfer-pricing legislation, and no Local File or Master File thresholds are defined in Vatu. Prudent benchmark practice for this gaming-technology group: maintain OECD-aligned Master File where consolidated group turnover exceeds VUV 300 million and a Local File where annual related-party cross-border flows exceed VUV 100 million, even though no domestic statutory threshold can be breached.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu's economic substance requirements, introduced through the 2021 amendments to the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], apply. A kernel-level anti-cheat business performing software licensing and SaaS middleware services likely falls within Intellectual Property Business and Distribution and Service Centre relevant activities. The IC must annually prove: (i) direction and management exercised in Vanuatu, (ii) CIGA performed in Vanuatu, (iii) adequate local employees, premises and operating expenditure, and (iv) no passive investment structure. Failure invalidates the IC's offshore status and enables foreign tax authorities to recharacterize the IC without OECD intervention.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Declaring no activity in Box 5 while executing paid anti-cheat engine licenses to global gaming publishers, or stating false CIGA locations to simulate substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal false-declaration fine of up to VT 10,000,000, restitution of any VAT or duty avoided, withdrawal of the IC exemption certificate, and publication of the enforcement action in the Official Gazette.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Signing directors are jointly and severally liable for civil restitution; directorship disqualification for five years; asset-freezing orders; and imprisonment of up to two years on conviction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a paper IC with no Vanuatu office, no local staff, no board meeting in-country, and zero local expenditure while the entire anti-cheat development, IP registration and contracting chain is executed by a foreign parent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC strike-off, notification to the OECD Global Forum, compulsory exchange-of-information activation, and a civil penalty of VT 5,000,000 plus investigation costs.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors face disqualification; ultimate owners are treated as de facto directors and may be made personally liable for restitution; travel bans and exit controls apply under the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2021.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving SWIFT or Stripe proceeds indirectly from sanctioned jurisdictions, settling invoices through third-party shell accounts, transferring funds to unregistered crypto exchanges, or omitting Suspicious Transaction Reports to the Vanuatu FIU.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2021 authorizes corporate fines up to VT 50,000,000, bank-account seizure, registered-agent licence revocation, and exclusion of the IC from the Vanuatu financial system.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the designated compliance officer face criminal liability of up to 15 years' imprisonment, personal confiscation orders, travel bans, and joint civil liability for all monies laundered through the IC.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling anti-cheat integrity services to Vanuatu-domiciled gaming operators, holding a domestic Vanuatu bank account funded by local-source revenue, or conducting operational meetings that constitute carrying on business within Vanuatu without a local service licence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Breach of the IC Act's domestic-trading prohibition: fine up to VT 1,000,000, retroactive VAT registration at 12.5% on all local supplies, VAT recovery with statutory late-payment surcharges, and forfeiture of the IC's offshore licence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approved local sales become personally liable for the unpaid VAT and penalties; a VT 1,000,000 civil damage order may be pursued by VFSC; the IC's tax-exemption clause is unenforceable against statutory restitution claims.
